periods.summary: Amane appears cheerfully before Ikki after Stella's match, but his claim that he will not fight Kiriko is proven when every inpatient at Kiriko's hospital suddenly becomes critical, forcing her to leave. Ikki deduces from this and Utakata's loss that Amane is not a future seer; instead, events reorder themselves to fulfill Amane's wishes. Amane confirms his Device ability, Excessive Goddess's Favor, has never failed, though he claims he only wishes and does not control the method. He offers to make Ikki the Seven Stars champion as an apology, but Ikki rejects the offer as an attack on the meaning of his effort and promise. Amane then reveals the dark core beneath his admiration: he wants to watch Ikki resist fate, suffer, bleed and collapse. The next day Ikki and Shizuku suspect Amane's power may also be behind the schedule compression that worsens Ikki's path.

key_events.summary: Kiriko leaves the tournament when Amane's wish causes hospital-wide crisis.
Ikki exposes Amane's real wish-granting luck power and refuses his championship gift.

periods.summary: Amane is discussed throughout the volume as an unknown, dangerous D-block survivor whose first two tournament matches ended without normal combat: Kiriko was pulled away by an emergency patient and the second opponent withdrew from food poisoning. Ikki and Stella know his real power is causality-warping luck, but the tournament staff still treats him as a lucky mystery. Shizuku says she has a secret plan against him. When the D-block third-round match is called, neither fighter enters; the broadcast switches to the waiting room and shows Amane drenched in blood, laughing, while Shizuku is pinned to the wall by many thin swords.

key_events.summary: Appears blood-covered and laughing beside Shizuku's crucified body before the scheduled match.

periods.summary: Amane survives Shizuku and Alice's supposedly fatal ambush through impossible luck, turns his causality against their movements, and pins Shizuku to the wall before publicly twisting her feelings for Ikki. Before the semifinal he tries to withdraw so his announced support of Ikki will taint the promised Ikki-Stella final. Ikki calls him by his original name, Amamiya Shion, after Tsukikage reveals his past: his miracle luck made classmates, teachers, mother, and father value only his power, pushing him to abandon his own self. Enraged, Amane fights. His luck makes even crude sword swings strike perfect angles, but Ikki's embodied sword mastery keeps recovering from every forced failure. Amane escalates to ordering Ikki's death by stopping his heart, only for Ikki to restart it and wound him. After losing the official match, Amane cannot accept that his supposedly absolute ability is merely one power among many and manifests black hands that impose the result of death. Ikki defeats the rampage while also giving him the words once given by Ryoma: never forget regret, because it proves he has not abandoned himself. In hospital, Amane asks whether Ikki lived, accepts Kiriko's message, agrees to accept punishment, and promises Nene not to interfere with the final.

key_events.summary: Survives and reverses Shizuku and Alice's ambush.
Attempts to withdraw so his future cheering will taint Ikki's final.
Loses when Ikki overcomes forced mistakes and heart stoppage.
Rages after defeat and manifests death-result black hands.
Learns Ikki survived and accepts a path toward earned regret and challenge.
